title: 更加, 不如, 相同, 同样 and 一天比一天: more, less, the same
explain: 更加 'even more' is like 更 (HSK 3) but a little more formal. It goes before adjectives and some verbs: 天气更加冷了 'The weather is even colder'; 他更加努力了 'He works even harder'. It compares with an earlier state.

A 不如 B means 'A is not as good as B': 这个手机不如那个手机好用 'This phone is not as easy to use as that one'. An adjective can follow B: 我不如他高 'I am not as tall as he is'. Compare 没有 (HSK 2): 这个没有那个好. 不如 can also suggest a better choice, 'might as well': 不如去睡觉吧 'we may as well go to sleep'.

相同 'the same, identical' and 同样 'in the same way, equally' say there is no difference: 我们的想法相同 'Our ideas are the same'; 他们同样很高兴 'They are equally happy'. 同样 can also come before a noun with 的: 同样的问题 'the same question'.
一 + measure word + 比 + 一 + measure word means 'each one more than the last': 天气一天比一天冷 'The weather is getting colder by the day'; 他的表演一次比一次精彩 'His performances get better every time'.

examples.zh: 天气更加冷了，多穿一点儿衣服吧。
examples.en: The weather is even colder now; wear a bit more clothing.

examples.zh: 这个手机不如那个手机好用。
examples.en: This phone is not as easy to use as that one.

examples.zh: 我们的想法完全相同。
examples.en: Our ideas are exactly the same.

examples.zh: 他们对这件事同样感兴趣。
examples.en: They are equally interested in this matter.

examples.zh: 天气一天比一天冷。
examples.en: The weather is getting colder by the day.

mistakes: 不如 compares two things, so you need both A and B. 这个不如好 is incomplete; say 这个不如那个好.
相同 does not take 很: 很相同 is wrong. Say 完全相同 'exactly the same' or 不太相同 'not quite the same'.
Keep both halves the same: 一天比一天, 一次比一次, 一年比一年.

q.en: He works even harder now than before.
I am not as tall as he is.
The meaning of these two characters is the same.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This is not as good as that?
q.en: This is not as good as that.
Our ideas are the same.
q.explain: 相同 does not take 很.

q.en: The weather is getting colder by the day.
q.explain: 一天 + 比 + 一天, then the adjective.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: His Chinese gets better every year?
options: 他的汉语一年比一年好。
他的汉语比一年一年好。
q.zh: 他的汉语一年比一年好。
q.en: His Chinese gets better every year.
q.explain: 一年 comes before and after 比.

title: 对于, 对…来说, 通过 and 随着: regarding, for, through, along with
explain: 对于 'regarding, as for' and 对 … 来说 'for, as far as … is concerned' name the person or topic that a judgement is about: 对于这个问题，我没有意见 'On this question, I have no opinion'; 对我来说，汉字很难 'For me, characters are hard'. 对…来说 is used with people; 对于 with topics.
通过 'through, by means of' tells the way you do something: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词 'By watching films, he has learned many words'. It also means 'to pass': 他通过了考试 'He passed the exam'.
随着 'along with, as' says that one thing changes together with another: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多 'As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more'. 随着 starts the sentence and is followed by a change.

examples.zh: 对于这个问题，我没有意见。
examples.en: On this question, I have no opinion.

examples.zh: 对我来说，汉字很难。
examples.en: For me, characters are hard.

examples.zh: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词。
examples.en: By watching films, he has learned many words.

examples.zh: 随着天气变冷，人们穿得越来越多。
examples.en: As the weather gets cold, people wear more and more.

mistakes: 对…来说 is for people: 对我来说, 对学生来说. Do not use it for a thing: 对天气来说 is wrong.
随着 needs a change after it. 随着天气 is not complete; say 随着天气变冷.

q.en: For me, this is very easy.
q.explain: 对 + person + 来说 gives the point of view.

q.zh: 通过看书，他学到了很多。
q.en: By reading, he learned a lot.
q.explain: 通过 + action = by means of.

q.zh: 随着他的汉语越来越好，他的朋友也越来越多。
q.en: As his Chinese gets better and better, he has more and more friends.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: On this matter, I agree?
q.en: On this matter, I agree.
q.explain: 对于 comes before the topic.

q.zh: 通过看电影，他学会了很多词。
q.en: By watching films, he has learned many words.
q.wrong: 通过看电影，他用学会了很多词。
q.explain: 通过 already means "by means of"; do not add 用.

title: 按照, 作为, 与…相比, 使, 表扬 and 选: according to, as, compared with, make
explain: 按照 'according to, in line with' is followed by a rule, a plan or an order, and then the action: 按照老师说的做 'Do it the way the teacher said'. 按照 is about following something. 根据 (HSK 3) is about the evidence a judgement rests on. 作为 'as, in the role of' says what role someone has: 作为学生，他应该努力学习 'As a student, he should study hard'.
与 … 相比 'compared with …' compares two things. 与 is the written form of 和, and 和 … 相比 is the spoken one: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了 'Compared with last year, there is more rain this year'.
使 'to make, to cause' is followed by a person and then a feeling or a state: 这个消息使我很高兴 'This news makes me very happy'. The subject is a thing or an event, not a person who acts on purpose.

Some verbs take a person and then a second verb about that person: 老师表扬我考得很好 'The teacher praised me for doing well in the exam'; 妈妈批评他回家太晚 'Mom told him off for coming home too late'; 大家选他当经理 'Everyone chose him as manager' (选 + person + 当 / 做 + role).

examples.zh: 请按照老师说的做。
examples.en: Please do it the way the teacher says.

examples.zh: 作为学生，他应该努力学习。
examples.en: As a student, he should study hard.

examples.zh: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了。
examples.en: Compared with last year, there is more rain this year.

examples.zh: 这个消息使我很高兴。
examples.en: This news makes me very happy.

examples.zh: 老师表扬我考得很好。
examples.en: The teacher praised me for doing well in the exam.

examples.zh: 大家选他当经理。
examples.en: Everyone chose him as manager.

mistakes: 使 is followed by a person and then the result. For a person who makes someone do a job, use 让.
与…相比 needs both parts: 与去年相比, then what is different.
The person comes right after 表扬, 批评 or 选: 大家选他当经理, not 大家选当经理他.

q.en: Please do it the way I say.

q.zh: 作为朋友，我应该帮助你。
q.en: As a friend, I should help you.

q.zh: 这个好消息使大家都很高兴。
q.en: This good news makes everyone happy.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Compared with last year, I am busier now?
q.en: Compared with last year, I am busier now.

q.zh: 与去年相比，今年的雨多了。
q.en: Compared with last year, there is more rain this year.
q.wrong: 与去年相比，今年的雨是多了。
q.explain: 相比 already makes the comparison; do not add 是.

q.en: The teacher praised me for doing well in the exam.
q.explain: 表扬 + person + what they did well.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Everyone chose him as manager?
q.en: Everyone chose him as manager.

title: 一…就… and 任何 / 随便: as soon as, any, as you like
explain: 一 … 就 … links two actions that follow each other closely: 我一到家就给你打电话 'I will call you as soon as I get home'. It also means 'whenever': 他一累就想睡觉 'Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep'. Put 一 before the first verb and 就 before the second.
The two verbs can have the same subject or different ones: 一下课，他就去打球 'As soon as class is over, he goes to play ball'.

任何 'any, whatever' is followed by a noun and then 都 or 也: 任何人都可以来 'Anyone can come'; 我没有任何问题 'I have no questions at all'. 随便 'as you like, casual' means there is no limit: 你随便坐 'Sit wherever you like'.

examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get home.

examples.zh: 他一累就想睡觉。
examples.en: Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep.

examples.zh: 任何人都可以来。
examples.en: Anyone can come.

examples.zh: 你随便坐，别客气。
examples.en: Sit wherever you like; do not stand on ceremony.

mistakes: Do not leave out 就 in the second part. 我一到家给你打电话 is not natural.
任何 needs 都 or 也 after the noun: 任何人可以来 is not complete.

q.en: As soon as class is over, he goes to play basketball.
I understand as soon as I look.
Call me as soon as you arrive.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Anyone can come?
q.en: Anyone can come.
Whenever he is tired, he wants to sleep.
q.explain: 一…就… already shows the link; do not add 所以.

title: 所有, 各, 一切, 许多, 大量, 部分, 全部 and 整个: all and many
explain: 所有 'all, every' comes before a noun and usually goes with 的 and 都: 所有的学生都来了 'All the students have come'. 各 'each, every one of' is used with a few nouns: 各国 'every country', 各位 'everyone'. 一切 'everything, all' stands for the whole of something: 一切都很好 'Everything is fine'.
许多 'many, a lot of' and 大量 'a large amount of' say that there is a lot. 许多 goes before nouns: 许多人 'many people'. 大量 is more formal and goes with amounts: 大量的时间 'a lot of time'.

部分 'part', 全部 'all of it' and 整个 'the whole' say how much of a thing: 我只看了一部分 'I only watched part of it'; 他吃了全部的菜 'He ate all the dishes'; 整个下午 'the whole afternoon'. 整个 takes one thing as a whole; 全部 is for the whole set.

examples.zh: 所有的学生都来了。
examples.en: All the students have come.

examples.zh: 一切都很好，请放心。
examples.en: Everything is fine; please rest assured.

examples.zh: 他有许多朋友。
examples.en: He has many friends.

examples.zh: 我睡了整个下午。
examples.en: I slept the whole afternoon.

mistakes: 所有 and 一切 usually need 都 in the sentence: 所有的学生来了 is not natural.
整个 takes one thing as a whole. For a whole set of things use 全部.

q.en: Everyone likes him.

q.zh: 他花了大量的时间学习。
q.en: He spent a lot of time studying.

q.zh: 我写了整个下午的作业。
q.en: I wrote homework the whole afternoon.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Everything is fine?
q.en: Everything is fine.
q.explain: 都 goes before the verb or adjective.

q.en: He has many friends.
q.explain: 许多 already means "many"; do not add 很.

title: 有的…有的… and 互相 / 共同: some … others, each other
explain: 有的 … 有的 … 'some … others …' splits a group into parts: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天 'Some people like summer, others like winter'. 有些 'some' works in the same pattern. You can leave out the noun after the second 有的.
互相 'each other, mutually' goes before the verb: 我们互相帮助 'We help each other'; 朋友们互相学习 'Friends learn from each other'. 互相 already means 'each other', so no object is needed.

共同 'common, together' works as an adjective or an adverb: 我们有共同的爱好 'We have a common hobby'; 大家共同努力 'Everyone works hard together'. 共同 is more formal than 一起 and stresses sharing the same goal or thing.

examples.zh: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天。
examples.en: Some people like summer, others like winter.

examples.zh: 这些书，有的好，有的不好。
examples.en: Of these books, some are good and some are not.

examples.zh: 我们互相帮助，一起学习汉语。
examples.en: We help each other and study Chinese together.

examples.zh: 我们有共同的爱好。
examples.en: We have a common hobby.

mistakes: 有的 … 有的 … needs two or more parts. One 有的 alone does not make the pattern; say 有的…，有的….
互相 goes before the verb, not after: 我们帮助互相 is wrong.

q.zh: 有的人喜欢夏天，有的人喜欢冬天。
q.en: Some people like summer and some like winter.
q.explain: 有的 … 有的 … splits the group.

q.en: Friends help each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes before the verb.

q.en: We have friends in common.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: We learn from each other?
q.en: We learn from each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes before the verb.

q.en: We help each other.
q.explain: 互相 goes straight before the verb; do not add 是.

title: 之前, 之后, 之间, 当时, 从此 and 接着: before, after, between, then
explain: 之前 'before' and 之后 'after' go after a time or an action: 三点之前 'before three o'clock'; 吃饭之前，先洗手 'Before eating, wash your hands first'; 下课之后 'after class'. They work like 以前 and 以后 (HSK 3) but are a little more formal.

之间 'between, among' goes after two things or two limits: 房子和学校之间 'between the house and the school'; 三点到五点之间 'between three and five'. 当时 'at that time, then' points back to a time already named: 我十岁的时候搬到这里，当时这里很小 'I moved here when I was ten; at that time it was small'.

从此 'from then on' says that after one event a new situation began: 他来到这里，从此没有离开 'He came here, and from then on has not left'. 接着 'next, then' follows the action just before it: 他先吃饭，接着看电视 'He eats first, then watches TV'.

examples.zh: 吃饭之前，先洗手。
examples.en: Before eating, wash your hands first.

examples.zh: 下课之后，我们去吃饭。
examples.en: After class, we go and eat.

examples.zh: 我十岁的时候搬到这里，当时这里很小。
examples.en: I moved here when I was ten; at that time it was small.

examples.zh: 他先吃饭，接着看电视。
examples.en: He eats first, then watches TV.

mistakes: 之前 and 之后 come after the time or action: 之前吃饭 is wrong. Say 吃饭之前.
从此 mostly marks a turning point in the past. For a plan, 以后 is the safer word, although 从此我要努力学习 is also possible.

q.en: Before going to bed, I must take a shower.
q.explain: 之前 comes after the action.

q.en: After class, he goes to play ball.
q.explain: 之后 comes after the action.

q.zh: 房子和学校之间有一个公园。
q.en: Between the house and the school there is a park.
q.explain: 之间 goes after the two things.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He ate, and then watched TV?
q.en: He ate, and then watched TV.
q.explain: 接着 follows the first action.

q.en: Before eating, wash your hands first.
q.explain: 之前 already means "before"; do not add 以前.

title: 说明, 表示 and 成为: shows, says, becomes
explain: 说明 has two uses: 'to explain' (请你说明一下 'Please explain') and 'to show that' something is true (这件事说明他很努力 'This shows that he works hard'). With a clause after it, it is a conclusion drawn from facts.
表示 'to express, to show' says what someone shows by words or acts: 他点头表示同意 'He nods to show agreement'; 他表示不同意 'He says he does not agree'. The subject is a person, or an act that shows a feeling.
成为 'to become' is followed by a noun, a job or a role: 他成为了一名医生 'He became a doctor'. For adjectives use 变得: 天气变得很冷 'The weather has become cold'.

examples.zh: 这件事说明他很努力。
examples.en: This shows that he works hard.

examples.zh: 请你说明一下这个问题。
examples.en: Please explain this problem.

examples.zh: 他点头表示同意。
examples.en: He nods to show agreement.

examples.zh: 他后来成为了一名医生。
examples.en: Later he became a doctor.

mistakes: 成为 is followed by a noun or a role, not an adjective: 他成为很高 is wrong. Say 他变得很高.
说明 for "explain" needs a thing to explain; 说明 for "show that" needs a clause after it.

q.zh: 他的成绩说明他很努力。
q.en: His results show that he works hard.
He nods to show agreement.

q.zh: 她后来成为了一名老师。
q.en: Later she became a teacher.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This shows that it is hard?
q.en: This shows that it is hard.
He wants to become a doctor.
q.explain: 成为 is followed straight by the noun; do not add 是.

title: Words you know, with a new meaning
explain: Some words you already know come back in HSK 4 with another meaning or another sound. The character is the same; the words around it tell you which one it is.

空 kòng means 'free time, a gap': 有空 'to be free', 没空 'to have no time'. 空 kōng is 'empty': 空的 'empty'. 重 chóng means 'again': 重新 'anew', 重来 'do it again'. 重 zhòng is 'heavy'. 干 gān means 'dry': 衣服干了 'The clothes are dry'; 干净 'clean' is gān too. 干 gàn is 'to do': 干什么.

等 děng at the end of a list means 'and so on, etc.': 苹果、西瓜等水果 'fruits such as apples and watermelons'. 生 also means 'raw' and 'unfamiliar': 生的 'raw', 生词 'a new word'. 种 zhòng means 'to plant': 种花 'plant flowers'. 种 zhǒng is 'kind': 这种水果.

着 zháo means 'to succeed in': 睡着 'fall asleep', 找着 'find'. 着 zhe shows a state: 门开着. 为 wéi means 'to be, to act as': 成为 'become', 作为 'as'. 为 wèi is 'for': 为你高兴. 两 liǎng is also a Chinese unit of weight, 50 grams: 二两 'two liang'. 啊 ā at the start of a sentence is a cry of surprise: 啊！是你！ 'Ah! It is you!'

examples.zh: 你明天有空吗？
examples.en: Are you free tomorrow?

examples.zh: 衣服干了，你可以穿了。
examples.en: The clothes are dry now; you can wear them.

examples.zh: 我喜欢苹果、西瓜等水果。
examples.en: I like fruits such as apples and watermelons.

examples.zh: 他在花园里种了很多花。
examples.en: He planted many flowers in the garden.

mistakes: The sound is decided by the words around: 你有空吗 is kòng, 杯子是空的 is kōng. 他睡着了 is zháo, 门开着 is zhe.
为 wèi 'for' goes before a person: 为你高兴. 成为 and 作为 use wéi.

q.en: Are you free tomorrow?
q.explain: 有空 kòng = to be free.

q.en: The clothes are dry now; you can wear them.

q.zh: 我喜欢苹果、西瓜等水果。
q.en: I like fruits such as apples and watermelons.
q.explain: 等 děng after a list = and so on.

q.zh: 他在花园里种了很多花。
q.en: He planted many flowers in the garden.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He has fallen asleep?
q.en: He has fallen asleep.
q.explain: 睡着 zháo = to fall asleep.

title: Numbers: 三分之一, 百分之二十, 两倍, 三十来个 and 一脸
explain: Fractions say the bottom number first: 三分之一 'one third', 四分之三 'three quarters'. Percentages use 百分之: 百分之二十 '20%'. Decimals use 点: 零点五 '0.5', 三点五 '3.5'.
倍 means 'times': 他的收入是我的两倍 'His income is twice mine'. 多了一倍 means 'doubled': 今年的游客比去年多了一倍 'There are twice as many visitors this year as last year'.
A round number + 来 + measure word means 'about': 三十来个学生 'about thirty students'; 四十来岁 'about forty years old'.

Some nouns can be used as measure words with 一 to mean 'all over, a whole …': 一脸高兴 'happy all over his face'; 一屋子人 'a roomful of people'. An adjective can go between 一 and the measure word: 一大碗米饭 'a big bowl of rice'; 一小杯咖啡 'a small cup of coffee'.

examples.zh: 三分之一的学生是外国人。
examples.en: One third of the students are foreigners.

examples.zh: 他的收入是我的两倍。
examples.en: His income is twice mine.

examples.zh: 教室里有三十来个学生。
examples.en: There are about thirty students in the classroom.

examples.zh: 她一脸高兴地跑了进来。
examples.en: She ran in, beaming.

mistakes: The bottom number comes first: 三分之一 is 1/3, not 3/1.
来 meaning 'about' goes after a round number: 三十来个, not 三来十个.

q.en: His income is twice mine.
q.explain: A 是 B 的 + number + 倍.

q.zh: 教室里有三十来个学生。
q.en: There are about thirty students in the classroom.
q.explain: Round number + 来 + measure word: about.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: One third of the students are foreigners?
options: 三分之一的学生是外国人。
一分之三的学生是外国人。
q.zh: 三分之一的学生是外国人。
q.en: One third of the students are foreigners.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: After the discount it is 20% cheaper?
options: 打折以后便宜了百分之二十。
打折以后便宜了二十百分。
q.zh: 打折以后便宜了百分之二十。
q.en: After the discount it is 20% cheaper.
q.explain: 百分之 comes before the number.

q.zh: 她一脸高兴地跑了进来。
q.en: She ran in, beaming.
q.explain: 一脸 + feeling: all over the face.

title: More pairs: 不仅…还…, 一方面…另一方面…, 不是…就是…
explain: 不仅…，还 / 而且… means 'not only … but also', a little more formal than 不但…而且…: 我不仅会说汉语，还会写汉字 'I can not only speak Chinese but also write characters'. 不光 means the same and sounds casual.
一方面…，另一方面… gives two sides or two reasons: 学汉语一方面有意思，另一方面很有用 'Learning Chinese is interesting on the one hand and useful on the other'.

不是…，就是… means 'either … or' (one of the two, nothing else): 周末他不是在家，就是在公园 'At weekends he is either at home or in the park'. Compare 不是…而是…, which corrects: 他不是老师，而是学生 'He is not a teacher but a student'.

examples.zh: 我不仅会说汉语，还会写汉字。
examples.en: I can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.

examples.zh: 学汉语一方面有意思，另一方面很有用。
examples.en: Learning Chinese is interesting on the one hand and useful on the other.

examples.zh: 周末他不是在家，就是在公园。
examples.en: At weekends he is either at home or in the park.

mistakes: 不是…就是… gives two choices; 不是…而是… corrects a mistake.
The second half is 另一方面, with 另.

q.zh: 我不仅会说汉语，还会写汉字。
q.en: I can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.

q.zh: 他不光是我的同事，也是我的好朋友。
q.en: He is not only my colleague but also my good friend.
q.explain: 不光 is the casual 不仅.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: This shop is cheap on the one hand and close to home on the other?
options: 这家店一方面便宜，另一方面离家近。
这家店一方面便宜，一方面另离家近。
q.zh: 这家店一方面便宜，另一方面离家近。
q.en: This shop is cheap on the one hand and close to home on the other.
q.explain: The second half starts with 另一方面.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: At weekends he is either at home or in the park?
options: 周末他不是在家，就是在公园。
周末他不是在家，而是在公园。
q.zh: 周末他不是在家，就是在公园。
q.en: At weekends he is either at home or in the park.
q.explain: 不是…就是… is either/or; 不是…而是… would mean "not at home but in the park".

q.zh: 他每天不是工作，就是学习。
q.en: Every day he is either working or studying.
q.explain: 不是 … 就是 …: one or the other.

title: 叫 and 让 for the passive, and more 把 sentences
explain: In speech, 叫 and 让 can work like 被: 我的自行车让朋友借走了 'My bike was borrowed by a friend'; 蛋糕叫弟弟吃了 'The cake was eaten by my little brother'. Unlike 被, they need the doer after them.

More 把 sentences: a doubled verb (你把衣服洗一洗 'Give your clothes a wash'); verb + 了 for something lost or forgotten (我把银行卡密码忘了 'I forgot my bank card PIN'); verb + 一顿 (妈妈把他批评了一顿 'Mom gave him a scolding'); and a direction before the verb (别把垃圾往地上扔 'Don't throw rubbish on the ground').

examples.zh: 我的自行车让朋友借走了。
examples.en: My bike was borrowed by a friend.

examples.zh: 蛋糕叫弟弟吃了。
examples.en: The cake was eaten by my little brother.

examples.zh: 我把银行卡密码忘了。
examples.en: I forgot my bank card PIN.

examples.zh: 别把垃圾往地上扔。
examples.en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.

mistakes: 叫 / 让 in the passive need the doer: 自行车让朋友借走了, not 自行车让借走了.
With 把 the verb cannot stand alone: 我把密码忘了, not 我把密码忘.

q.zh: 我的自行车让朋友借走了。
q.en: My bike was borrowed by a friend.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: The cake was eaten by my little brother?
q.en: The cake was eaten by my little brother.
q.explain: The doer comes right after 叫.

q.en: I forgot my bank card PIN.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Mom gave him a scolding?
q.en: Mom gave him a scolding.
q.explain: 一顿 comes after the verb.

q.en: Don't throw rubbish on the ground.
q.explain: 把 + thing + 往 + place + verb.

title: Saying it strongly: 累死了, 谁不…？, 没有…不… and 够…的
explain: Adjective or feeling + 死了 means 'terribly' in casual speech: 我累死了 'I'm dead tired'; 考试的时候，我紧张死了 'I was terribly nervous in the exam'. 得厉害 means 'badly, a lot': 他头疼得厉害 'His head hurts badly'.
A question with a question word can say the opposite, for emphasis: 谁不认识他？ 'Who doesn't know him?' (everyone does); 我怎么知道？ 'How would I know?' (I don't).
Two negatives make a strong yes: 没有人不喜欢放假 'There is nobody who doesn't like holidays' (everyone does); 我不能不去 'I can't not go' (I must).
够…的 means 'really, quite' and is casual: 这个房间真够大的 'This room is really big'. Keep the 的 at the end.

examples.zh: 我累死了。
examples.en: I'm dead tired.

examples.zh: 谁不认识他？
examples.en: Who doesn't know him?

examples.zh: 没有人不喜欢放假。
examples.en: There is nobody who doesn't like holidays.

examples.zh: 这个房间真够大的。
examples.en: This room is really big.

mistakes: 死了 is casual; in polite or written Chinese use 非常 or 十分.
够…的 needs the 的: 真够大的.

q.zh: 考试的时候，我紧张死了。
q.en: I was terribly nervous in the exam.

q.prompt: Which sentence means: everyone knows him?
q.en: Who doesn't know him?
There is nobody who doesn't like holidays.
This room is really big.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: His head hurts badly?
q.en: His head hurts badly.

title: Frames: 在…方面, 为了…而… and 拿…来说
explain: 在…方面 means 'when it comes to, in the area of': 在工作方面，他很有经验 'When it comes to work, he is very experienced'. It is a little more formal than 在…上.
为了…而… means 'do something for the sake of …': 他为了家人而努力工作 'He works hard for his family'. 而 links the reason to the action and sounds written.
拿…来说 means 'take … for example': 我的朋友都很忙，拿我姐姐来说，她每天工作十个小时 'My friends are all busy. Take my sister: she works ten hours a day'.

examples.zh: 在工作方面，他很有经验。
examples.en: When it comes to work, he is very experienced.

examples.zh: 为了梦想而努力的人值得我们学习。
examples.en: We should learn from people who work hard for their dreams.

examples.zh: 拿我来说，我每天都跑步。
examples.en: Take me, for example: I run every day.

mistakes: 在…方面 needs 方面 at the end: 在工作方面.
拿…来说 introduces an example, so what follows is about that example.

q.zh: 在工作方面，他很有经验。
q.en: When it comes to work, he is very experienced.
q.explain: 在 + area + 方面 at the start.

q.zh: 为了梦想而努力的人值得我们学习。
q.en: We should learn from people who work hard for their dreams.
q.explain: 为了 (or 为) … 而 + action.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Take me, for example: I run every day?
options: 拿我来说，我每天都跑步。
拿我说来，我每天都跑步。
q.zh: 拿我来说，我每天都跑步。
q.en: Take me, for example: I run every day.

q.zh: 在教育孩子方面，她很有经验。
q.en: When it comes to raising children, she is very experienced.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He works hard for his family?
options: 他为了家人而努力工作。
他为了家人努力而工作。
q.zh: 他为了家人而努力工作。
q.en: He works hard for his family.
q.explain: 而 comes right after the reason.

title: Four-word patterns: 一A一B, 无A无B and 有A有B
explain: 一A一B puts 一 before two related words: 一字一句 'word by word'; 一前一后 'one in front, one behind'; 一大一小 'one big, one small'.
无A无B means 'without either': 无儿无女 'with no children'.
有A有B means 'with both, plenty of': 有说有笑 'chatting and laughing'; 有山有水 'with hills and water'; 有吃有喝 'plenty to eat and drink'.

examples.zh: 她一字一句说得很清楚。
examples.en: She says every word clearly.

examples.zh: 他们一前一后走进了教室。
examples.en: They walked into the classroom one behind the other.

examples.zh: 那位老人无儿无女。
examples.en: That old man has no children.

examples.zh: 同学们有说有笑地走出了教室。
examples.en: The students walked out of the classroom chatting and laughing.

mistakes: These are fixed: do not add 和 or 的 between the parts: 有说有笑, not 有说和有笑.

q.zh: 同学们有说有笑地走出了教室。
q.en: The students walked out of the classroom chatting and laughing.

q.zh: 他们一前一后走进了教室。
q.en: They walked into the classroom one behind the other.
q.explain: 一前一后: one in front, one behind.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: She says every word clearly?
options: 她一字一句说得很清楚。
她一字一个句说得很清楚。
q.zh: 她一字一句说得很清楚。
q.en: She says every word clearly.
q.explain: The pattern is 一字一句.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: That old man has no children?
q.en: That old man has no children.
q.explain: 无儿无女: no sons and no daughters.

q.en: With hills and water, it is beautiful here.

title: Handy phrases: 有的是, 说不定, 不怎么, 就是说
formula: *有的是 / *说不定 / *不怎么 / *就是说
explain: 有的是 means 'plenty of': 别着急，我们有的是时间 'Don't worry, we have plenty of time'. Don't mix it up with 有的…, 'some': 有的人 'some people'.
说不定 means 'maybe, it could be': 他说不定已经到家了 'He may be home already'; 客人来不来还说不定 'It is not certain yet whether the guests will come'.
不怎么 + verb or adjective means 'not much, not very': 我不怎么喜欢喝咖啡 'I don't much like coffee'; 这个菜不怎么辣 'This dish is not very spicy'. Compare 不怎么样 'not great'.
(这)就是说 means 'that is to say, in other words': 他没有直接拒绝，这就是说，你还有机会 'He didn't turn you down directly; that is to say, you still have a chance'.

examples.zh: 别着急，我们有的是时间。
examples.en: Don't worry, we have plenty of time.

examples.zh: 他说不定已经到家了。
examples.en: He may be home already.

examples.zh: 我不怎么喜欢喝咖啡。
examples.en: I don't much like coffee.

examples.zh: 他没有直接拒绝，这就是说，你还有机会。
examples.en: He didn't turn you down directly; that is to say, you still have a chance.

mistakes: 不怎么 goes before a verb or adjective: 不怎么喜欢. On its own, say 不怎么样.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Don't worry, we have plenty of time?
options: 别着急，我们有的是时间。
别着急，我们是有的时间。
q.zh: 别着急，我们有的是时间。
q.en: Don't worry, we have plenty of time.
q.explain: 有的是 + what you have plenty of.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: He may be home already?
q.en: He may be home already.
I don't much like coffee.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: That is to say, you still have a chance?
q.en: That is to say, you still have a chance.
q.explain: 这就是说: in other words.

q.en: It is not certain yet whether the guests will come.
q.explain: 还说不定: not certain yet.

title: Can and never: 吃得了, 再也不, 怎么也…不
explain: Verb + 得了 / 不了 says whether you can manage it: 这么多菜，我们吃得了吗？ 'Can we finish this much food?'; 明天我去不了 'I can't go tomorrow'. Here 了 is read liǎo.
再也不 / 再也没 means 'never again': 我保证再也不迟到了 'I promise never to be late again'; 我再也没见过他 'I never saw him again'.
怎么都 / 怎么也 + 不 / 没 means 'however hard, still not': 我怎么也想不起来他的名字 'I just can't remember his name'; 他们怎么都找不到 'However hard they looked, they couldn't find it'.

examples.zh: 这么多菜，我们吃得了吗？
examples.en: Can we finish this much food?

examples.zh: 明天我去不了。
examples.en: I can't go tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我保证再也不迟到了。
examples.en: I promise never to be late again.

examples.zh: 我怎么也想不起来他的名字。
examples.en: I just can't think of his name.

mistakes: 再也 goes before 不 / 没: 再也不, not 不再也.
In 得了 / 不了 the 了 is liǎo, not le.

q.en: I can't go tomorrow.
q.explain: Verb + 不了: cannot manage it.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: I promise never to be late again?
q.en: I promise never to be late again.

q.zh: 我怎么也想不起来他的名字。
q.en: I just can't think of his name.
q.explain: 怎么也 + 不: however hard.

q.prompt: Which sentence asks: Can we finish this much food?
options: 这么多菜，我们吃得了吗？
这么多菜，我们吃了得吗？
q.zh: 这么多菜，我们吃得了吗？
q.en: Can we finish this much food?
I never saw him again.

title: Spoken patterns (1): 有什么好怕的, 他是他，我是我, 说就是了
explain: 有什么(好) + verb or adjective + 的 means 'there is nothing to …': 有什么好害怕的？ 'What is there to be afraid of?'.
X是X，Y是Y keeps two things apart: 他是他，我是我 'He is he and I am I'; 工作是工作，生活是生活 'Work is work and life is life'.
X也得X，不X也得X means 'you have to, like it or not': 你去也得去，不去也得去.
X就是了 at the end means 'just do it, that's all': 有什么想法，说就是了 'If you have an idea, just say it'.
还 + noun + 呢 mocks something that does not live up to its name: 还大饭店呢，菜这么难吃 'Call this a big restaurant? The food is so bad'.
Verb + 一X是一X means 'one at a time, with no plan': 过一天是一天 'live one day at a time'; 走一步是一步 'take it one step at a time' (走一步算一步 is just as common).

examples.zh: 有什么好害怕的？
examples.en: What is there to be afraid of?

examples.zh: 他是他，我是我。
examples.en: He is he and I am I.

examples.zh: 你去也得去，不去也得去。
examples.en: You have to go, like it or not.

examples.zh: 有什么想法，说就是了。
examples.en: If you have an idea, just say it.

examples.zh: 还大饭店呢，菜这么难吃。
examples.en: Some big restaurant this is: the food is so bad.

examples.zh: 我们只能走一步是一步。
examples.en: We can only take it one step at a time.

mistakes: These are casual spoken patterns; don't use them in formal writing.
还…呢 is sarcastic: it criticises.

q.en: What is there to be afraid of?
He is he and I am I.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: You have to go, like it or not?
options: 你去也得去，不去也得去。
q.zh: 你去也得去，不去也得去。
q.en: You have to go, like it or not.
If you have an idea, just say it.
q.explain: Verb + 就是了: just do it.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: Some big restaurant this is: the food is so bad.
options: 还大饭店呢，菜这么难吃。
是大饭店呢，菜这么难吃。
q.zh: 还大饭店呢，菜这么难吃。
q.en: Some big restaurant this is: the food is so bad.

q.zh: 现在只能过一天是一天。
q.en: Right now all you can do is live one day at a time.

title: Spoken patterns (2): 你吃你的, 买就买吧, 便宜是便宜
explain: 你 + verb + 你的(吧) means 'go ahead with yours, don't mind me': 我不饿，你吃你的吧 'I'm not hungry, go ahead and eat'.
让你X你就X means 'just do as you are told': 老师让你多练，你就多练.
说什么也得X means 'whatever happens, must': 他病了，我说什么也得去看看他 'He's ill; I must go and see him no matter what'. With 不 it means 'won't, whatever you say': 他说什么也不同意.
X就X吧 accepts something: 'fine, then': 买就买吧，也不太贵 'Fine, buy it then; it's not that expensive'.
X是X，就是 / 可是… admits one point and then adds a 'but': 这些衣服便宜是便宜，就是质量不太好 'These clothes are cheap all right, but the quality isn't great'.

examples.zh: 我不饿，你吃你的吧。
examples.en: I'm not hungry, you go ahead and eat.

examples.zh: 老师让你多练，你就多练。
examples.en: If the teacher tells you to practise more, just practise more.

examples.zh: 他病了，我说什么也得去看看他。
examples.en: He's ill; I must go and see him, whatever happens.

examples.zh: 买就买吧，也不太贵。
examples.en: Fine, buy it then; it's not that expensive.

examples.zh: 这些衣服便宜是便宜，就是质量不太好。
examples.en: These clothes are cheap all right, but the quality isn't great.

mistakes: In X是X the same word comes twice with nothing added: 便宜是便宜, not 便宜是很便宜.

q.en: I'm not hungry, you go ahead and eat.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: If the teacher tells you to practise more, just practise more?
options: 老师让你多练，你就多练。
老师让你多练，你多就练。
q.zh: 老师让你多练，你就多练。
q.en: If the teacher tells you to practise more, just practise more.

q.zh: 他病了，我说什么也得去看看他。
q.en: He's ill; I must go and see him, whatever happens.
Fine, buy it then; it's not that expensive.

q.prompt: Which sentence says: These clothes are cheap all right, but the quality isn't great?
options: 这些衣服便宜是便宜，就是质量不太好。
这些衣服是便宜便宜，就是质量不太好。
q.zh: 这些衣服便宜是便宜，就是质量不太好。
q.en: These clothes are cheap all right, but the quality isn't great.
q.explain: X是X, then 就是 + the problem.
